disclaimer: Injury statuses reflect training camp reports as of Aug. 9, 2026 (night update). New: Jayden Reed (GB) added as questionable with a foot sprain; Kyler Gordon (CHI) added as out on PUP with a lingering calf strain. Refreshed: Malik Nabers (NYG) now trending toward playing Week 1 vs. Dallas after 9-of-10 padded practices with no setback; Laremy Tunsil (WAS) replacement plan updated - Brandon Coleman, not Andrew Wylie, is the frontrunner at left tackle. All other tracked situations (Emmanwori, Kittle, Pearsall, Evans, Bryant, Ekwonu, Moton, Scourton, Stewart, Bresee, Owusu-Koramoah, Tua, Penix, Walker, Ramsey, Parsons, Jacobs, Jefferson, Greenard, DeVonta Smith, Mahomes) confirmed unchanged after a fresh check of today's camp news. Pre-season camp/PUP-list information, not an official in-season practice-participation report - verify and update once real weekly injury reports are available.

injury.note: Had a minor arthroscopic procedure earlier this month on lingering soreness from an ankle injury first suffered before Super Bowl LX. Opened camp on PUP; Seahawks expect him ready for the Sept. 9 season opener vs. New England.
Suffered in the 49ers' Jan. 11 playoff win over the Eagles. Opened training camp on the PUP list; GM John Lynch says the rehab is 'coming tremendous.'

GM John Lynch announced Pearsall will have surgery on his PCL and is out for the entire 2026 season; placed on injured reserve. Recurring swelling in the same knee had limited him to two camp practices. 49ers re-signed Deebo Samuel in response.

Missed Monday's practice with a quad strain, his first missed session since signing a 3-year, $60.4M deal with San Francisco this offseason after 12 seasons in Tampa Bay. Considered minor and could resolve relatively quickly, per Ian Rapoport; no firm return date given.

injury.type: Hyperextended left knee, bone bruise, small fracture
injury.note: Hurt in one-on-one drills during the Bears' first padded training camp practice. Expected to miss 8-10 weeks; no surgery required, per Adam Schefter. Was Chicago's marquee free-agent addition this offseason (3-year, $40M deal).

Opened training camp on the PUP list with a calf injury that also sidelined him for OTAs and minicamp. GM Ryan Poles said Aug. 6 there's been a frustrating 'delay' in his recovery with no firm return timetable; Gordon says he believes he'll be ready soon.

injury.type: Ruptured patellar tendon (right knee) - surgically repaired
injury.note: Suffered in the Panthers' January playoff loss to the Rams; underwent surgery to repair the tendon. Rehab is reportedly "ahead of schedule" and the Panthers are "really feeling good" about his progress, per team reporting. On PUP to open camp; GM Dan Morgan remains optimistic he can return at some point this season.
Non-contact tear suffered on the first day of training camp practice — out for the season. The injury happened during the mandatory acclimation period, which the NFLPA is investigating.

Diagnosed with a blood clot in his lung in late June and placed on the reserve/non-football injury (NFI) list; immediately started on blood thinners and is reportedly responding well to treatment. Expected to miss the start of the regular season, per ESPN, though the team believes he could return at some point during the year.

Carted off during Cincinnati's first padded/11-on-11 practice with a hyperextended knee; follow-up testing showed no ligament damage. Coach Zac Taylor confirmed Aug. 7 he'll be out 'several weeks' but is expected back well before the regular season ends.

HC Kellen Moore confirmed Aug. 2 that Bresee's non-contact knee injury from the first day of camp is a torn ACL and he will undergo season-ending surgery, missing all of 2026. Started all 15 games in 2025.
Originally hurt in an October 2024 collision with Derrick Henry. Placed on reserve/PUP for a second straight season; not expected to play in 2026.

Recovering from left knee ACL surgery on Nov. 25. Limited to individual/7-on-7 work, not yet cleared for 11-on-11s; reportedly could be another ~4 weeks from full clearance and 'probably won't' play Week 1.

Carted off during an 11-on-11 period at Tuesday's practice; an MRI later that evening confirmed a torn ACL, per The Athletic's Josh Kendall. The 2025 first-round pick (No. 15 overall) will miss the entire 2026 season.

Hurt during minicamp; opened camp on PUP, no surgery required. Began light rehab (stretching, jogging) Aug. 1-2, but Steelers Depot's Mark Kaboly said Aug. 7 he 'wouldn't anticipate' Ramsey practicing at all during camp - next appearance may come at the Sept. 13 season opener vs. the Jets.

Suffered a torn ACL plus meniscus repair in Week 15 last season vs. Denver. On PUP to open camp; on Aug. 4-5 Parsons said a Week 6 return (Oct. 18, SNF vs. his old team the Cowboys at Lambeau) is 'very realistic,' though he cautioned 'it's not off the board, but we've got to put the work in' - no guarantee yet.

New to Green Bay's camp injury report in early August with a sprained foot. Coach Matt LaFleur says he's hopeful Reed will be ready for the Sept. 7 season opener vs. Detroit, though the team is proceeding cautiously with the soft-tissue issue.
Left practice July 24 with a hamstring strain that an MRI confirmed as mild. Returned to practice July 29; Week 1 vs. Chicago (Sept. 8) remains the target for full speed.

Hurt in a one-on-one pass-rush rep vs. Odafe Oweh during Saturday's practice. Expected to need surgery and miss a significant portion of the 2026 season, per NFL Network. Washington's plan is to move Brandon Coleman back to left tackle to replace him, with Andrew Wylie as a depth option.

Strained lifting weights ahead of camp; placed on PUP list on the first day of training camp. Traded to Philadelphia from Minnesota in April 2026 on a 4-year, $100M deal; injury is not expected to be long-term.

Missed practice all week (Mon.-Fri., Aug. 3-7) with a hamstring injury suffered at Eagles training camp; the team says it's not serious and there's no long-term concern, but is being handled cautiously as a soft-tissue issue with no firm return timetable.

Recovering from a torn ACL/meniscus suffered in Week 4 last season vs. the Chargers, plus a follow-up spring surgery to clear scar tissue. Participated in 9 of 10 padded camp practices without a setback and is now cutting/planting on the knee; as of Aug. 9 he's reportedly trending toward being ready for the Week 1 opener vs. Dallas, though coach John Harbaugh continues to manage his workload day-to-day and hasn't made it official.

Suffered the injury Dec. 14, 2025 vs. the Chargers, ending his 2025 season; had knee debridement surgery in May. Fully cleared off the PUP list for camp and has been a full practice participant, including 11-on-11 team drills, since late July.
